analysis.summary: Akiko Global Services Limited held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call, discussing strong financial performance, steady core business growth, and hybrid fintech initiatives. Management highlighted the near-complete development and rollout of AkikoPay on Android and iOS platforms to build a recurring income stream through cross-selling financial services. The company revised its FY27 revenue target upwards to INR325 crores to INR350 crores and maintained a positive outlook on PAT margins. Additionally, management addressed queries regarding branch expansion, employee count, and the absence of any immediate fundraising plans. Akiko Global Services Limited released its investor presentation for Q1 FY27, highlighting robust revenue growth and profitable operations driven by its credit card sourcing and lending businesses.

guidance.claim: Management revised the FY27 revenue guidance to INR325 crores to INR350 crores.
guidance.quote: Earlier, I had given a target of INR300 crores. Now I am revising this guidance. I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects PAT margins for the year to be between 9% to 11%.
guidance.quote: Sir, I am confident of 9% to 11% for this year.

guidance.claim: Management projected that if AkikoPay performs very well, next year's PAT margins will increase to 12% to 14%.
guidance.quote: If AkikoPay works very well, next year that will go up to 12% to 14%.

guidance.claim: Management targets a CAGR of 70% to 100% on a year-on-year basis for the next 3 years.
guidance.quote: Because my vision is very clear for the next 3 years that our CAGR will remain the same at 70% to 100% year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300 to ₹325 crore with healthy profitability.
guidance.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

guidance.claim: Management expects 70% to 100% revenue growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: I would like to give an outlook for FY27, which approximately I am expecting a target of 70% to 100% revenue growth, we have taken a minimum.

guidance.claim: The company maintains a long-term vision to reach INR 1,000 crores in revenue by 2030 with PAT margins of 12% to 13%.
guidance.quote: And we have also taken a long-term vision of 2030. We have a proper clear vision that we build INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and take PAT margins further to 12% to 13%.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue between INR 50 crores to INR 100 crores from AkikoPay in FY27.
guidance.quote: From AkikoPay, I am expecting revenue in the first quarter because AkikoPay is properly indulged with our core business. If seen, I am expecting AkikoPay revenue of INR50 crores to INR100 crores in FY27.

guidance.claim: The full year revenue outlook for FY27 is expected to be above INR 300 crores.
guidance.quote: Otherwise, I am expecting my outlook for 2027 is INR300 crores. That is not going below INR300 crores, this is going to be above INR300 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Bank partnerships remain strong and the sourcing pipeline is healthy, providing good visibility for upcoming quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: Bank partnerships are strong, and the sourcing pipeline is healthy, due to which we see good visibility for the upcoming quarters as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Personal loan business is growing at 5% to 10% month-on-month.
demand_outlook.quote: Where offline business is concerned, offline business has personal loans, so our personal loan business is growing 5% to 10% month-on-month, so that will also drive us as it has been driving.

demand_outlook.claim: Core business and distribution are increasing month-on-month by 4% to 7%.
demand_outlook.quote: Unlike other fintechs that burn money in their initial years, we are not focusing on losing money at all because our offline business, our core business, and our distribution are increasing month-on-month by 4% to 7%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that digital lead generation is strong, and physical servicing networks significantly improve conversion rates.
demand_outlook.quote: Digital lead generation is important, but a strong physical servicing network improves both conversion and customer experience.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has 25 branches across 19 cities in India.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we have 25 branches across 19 cities in India.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans a total of 25 branches for this year with upcoming locations in Indore and Kerala.
capex_expansion.quote: Over the next 2-3 months, a couple of more branches are lined up, with one opening in Indore and one towards Kerala.

capex_expansion.claim: All company branches are on rent or lease and none are owned.
capex_expansion.quote: All are on rent/lease. None are owned.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its company-owned branch presence in multiple cities including Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, and others.
capex_expansion.quote: Along with this, we have also expanded our company-owned branch presence in multiple cities. Like Delhi NCR is known to everyone, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Pune, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Lucknow, Kolkata, Patna, and many emerging markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The physical branch footprint has increased from three or four branches in the last quarter to 16 branches across India.
capex_expansion.quote: I mean, where we had three or four branches in the last quarter, today we have 16 branches across India.

margins_costs.claim: In unsecured loans, the company's average payout is 3.10%.
margins_costs.quote: In unsecured, our average payout itself is 3.10%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 stood at 14.8 percent.
Q4 margins experienced temporary pressure due to planned investments in branch expansion, technology infrastructure, and AkikoPay scale-up.
margins_costs.quote: One question many people are asking me is that there has been some pressure on margins in Q4. This was due to our planned investment towards branch expansion, this was the most important thing, in which some of our money has been spent on that.

margins_costs.claim: Dubai operations faced temporary margin pressure due to the geopolitical situation around the Iran region.
margins_costs.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

orders_capacity.claim: The current team strength includes 16 people on the tech side and about 700 executives on the sales side.
orders_capacity.quote: That means 100 people to 120 people oversee our business -- whether they are business heads, team leaders, team managers, or branch heads. Apart from that, we have between 700 executives to 750 executives. And on the tech side, there are 16 people.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly loan disbursals increased to over ₹450 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational execution remained strong during the quarter, with monthly loan disbursals increasing to over ₹450 crore, while monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards, driven by the Company's expanding distribution capabilities, technology-enabled customer acquisition platform, and deep banking and NBFC partnerships.

orders_capacity.claim: The monthly loan disbursement run rate has reached INR 400 crores plus.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we have reached a monthly disbursement run rate of INR400 crores+, which if we count annually, our book has become INR5,000 crores as of today.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated there are absolutely no plans for fundraising for the next 6 months to 1 year.
capital_allocation.quote: No, sir. There is absolutely no plan for fundraising right now. Even banks are supporting us very well. So, our CC limits are well aligned. So, no need for any fundraising for the next 6 months or 1 year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Total revenue for the Dubai business was INR1.25 crores for the quarter due to pressure from war.
risks_headwinds.quote: In Dubai, due to war, our total revenue for the entire quarter was INR1.25 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical issues around the Iran region caused temporary headwinds for Dubai operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the Apple App Store version will be implemented and live within a week.
management_commitments.quote: Customers are also really liking our new Android version and this same version will be implemented on Apple's App Store within a week.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects receivable days to come down to within 90 days in Q2.
management_commitments.quote: In Q2, I see receivable days coming down to within 90 days.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets employee count to reach 1,400 to 1,500 plus and monthly loan disbursements to reach INR1,000 crores by December end.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, our vision is that in this quarter, our employee count should reach 1,400 to 1,500, plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

management_commitments.claim: Integration of insurance and mutual funds will take 2 months, leading to business visibility in the next quarter.
management_commitments.quote: That will take 2 months. So, in the next quarter, you will see business visibility for insurance and mutual funds within it.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to reach a maximum number of AkikoPay users by December.
management_commitments.quote: In terms of users -- look, users I cannot commit, but my vision is to reach a maximum number of users by December.

management_commitments.claim: The iOS version of AkikoPay is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.
management_commitments.quote: The iOS version is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300 to ₹325 crore with healthy profitability.
management_commitments.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

management_commitments.claim: AkikoPay will be live on iOS with all features within the month.
management_commitments.quote: So most likely within this month, AkikoPay will be live on iOS with all features.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to reach 5 lakh customers on AkikoPay by September 30th.
management_commitments.quote: Yes. In this I have planned that in quarter one or two, we will be live everywhere, so I am expecting 5 lakh customers by 30th of September and 1 million customers till 31st December.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets an unsecured book of INR 1,000 crores by March 31st.
management_commitments.quote: By FY27, my target is INR1,000 crores of unsecured book. So, the INR400 crores is to be taken to INR1,000 crores. This is my complete vision, complete target till 31st March.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
